sn55.51:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ||
sn55.51:2.1: katamehi catuhi || || Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti || Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti || Dhamme || Saṅghe || Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || || Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || || Idam avoca Bhagavā || || Yassa saddhā Tathāgate || acaḷā suppatiṭṭhitā || sīlaṃ
sn55.51:4.1: Saṅghe pasādo yassatthi || ujubhūtaṃ ca dassanaṃ || Adaliddo ti tam āhu || amoghaṃ tassa jīvitaṃ ||||
sn55.51:5.1: Tasmā saddhañca sīlañca || pasādaṃ dhammadassanaṃ || anuyuñjetha medhāvī || saram buddhānasāsanan ti ||||
